crossRefs.note: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey…
Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to…
by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone…
Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall…
You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to…
Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has…
saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four…

translations.web: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.
translations.bsb: When you have mapped out the seven portions of land and brought it to me, I will cast lots for you here in the presence of the LORD our God.
translations.kjv: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
translations.asv: And ye shall describe the land into seven portions, and bring the description hither to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Jehovah our God.
